WITH p(per, d0, d1) AS (VALUES ('PY', DATE '2024-10-28', DATE '2025-01-26'), ('CY', DATE '2025-10-27', DATE '2026-01-25')),
s AS (
 SELECT p.per, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_all, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) ex_staff,
        count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) sale_days, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
 WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (
 SELECT p.per, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret_all, sum(CASE WHEN sl.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE r.refund_net END) ret_ex_staff
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
 LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
 WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2),
q AS (
 SELECT p.per, d.store_id, sum(d.net_sales) rpt_net, sum(d.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, sum(d.returns_net) rpt_ret, count(*) rpt_days
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales d JOIN p ON d.business_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE d.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT s.per, s.store_id, s.gross_all, s.ex_staff, coalesce(r.ret_all,0) ret_all, coalesce(r.ret_ex_staff,0) ret_ex, q.rpt_gross, q.rpt_ret, q.rpt_net, s.sale_days, q.rpt_days, s.mn, s.mx
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (per, store_id) LEFT JOIN q USING (per, store_id) ORDER BY s.store_id, s.per DESC

WITH days AS (
 SELECT calendar_date, day_name, is_trading_day, holiday_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_week,
  CASE WHEN calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'PY' ELSE 'CY' END per
 FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'),
sales AS (SELECT business_date, sum(net_sales) ns, count(*) stores, sum(CASE WHEN net_sales_before_returns>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) selling FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.per, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.stores, s.selling, s.ns
FROM days d LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE NOT d.is_trading_day OR d.holiday_name IS NOT NULL OR s.selling IS NULL OR s.selling<38 OR s.ns IS NULL
ORDER BY d.per DESC, d.calendar_date

WITH p(per, d0, d1) AS (VALUES ('PY', DATE '2024-10-28', DATE '2025-01-26'), ('CY', DATE '2025-10-27', DATE '2026-01-25')),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region AS cur_region, open_date, close_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
lfl AS (
  SELECT c.* FROM cur c
  WHERE (c.open_date IS NULL OR c.open_date <= DATE '2024-10-28')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure z JOIN p ON z.closure_start_date <= p.d1 AND z.closure_end_date >= p.d0 WHERE z.store_id = c.store_id)),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, f.staff_purchase_flag AS staff, st.region AS booked_region, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE st.store_id < 900),
rets AS (
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, coalesce(sl.staff_purchase_flag, false) AS staff, st.region AS booked_region, -r.refund_net AS amt
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1
  LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id WHERE st.store_id < 900),
allv AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets),
agg AS (
  SELECT l.cur_region AS region,
    sum(CASE WHEN per='PY' THEN amt END) py, sum(CASE WHEN per='CY' THEN amt END) cy,
    sum(CASE WHEN per='PY' AND l.store_id<>136 THEN amt END) py_x136, sum(CASE WHEN per='CY' AND l.store_id<>136 THEN amt END) cy_x136,
    sum(CASE WHEN per='PY' AND l.store_id<>129 THEN amt END) py_x129, sum(CASE WHEN per='CY' AND l.store_id<>129 THEN amt END) cy_x129,
    sum(CASE WHEN per='PY' AND NOT staff THEN amt END) py_xstaff, sum(CASE WHEN per='CY' AND NOT staff THEN amt END) cy_xstaff,
    sum(CASE WHEN per='PY' AND l.store_id<>104 AND l.store_id<>119 THEN amt END) py_xrefit, sum(CASE WHEN per='CY' AND l.store_id<>104 AND l.store_id<>119 THEN amt END) cy_xrefit,
    count(DISTINCT l.store_id) n_stores
  FROM allv a JOIN lfl l USING (store_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT region, n_stores, round(py,2) py, round(cy,2) cy, round((cy/py-1)*100,2) g_main,
  round((cy_x136/py_x136-1)*100,2) g_x136, round((cy_x129/py_x129-1)*100,2) g_x129, round((cy_xstaff/py_xstaff-1)*100,2) g_xstaff, round((cy_xrefit/py_xrefit-1)*100,2) g_xrefit
FROM agg ORDER BY region

SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date)::DATE AS m, 
 round(sum(CASE WHEN store_id=136 THEN net_sales_before_returns END),0) s136,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN store_id=137 THEN net_sales_before_returns END),0) s137,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN store_id=117 THEN net_sales_before_returns END),0) s117_similar_size,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN store_id=118 THEN net_sales_before_returns END),0) s118
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id IN (136,137,117,118) AND business_date >= DATE '2024-08-01' AND business_date <= DATE '2026-02-28'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p(per, d0, d1) AS (VALUES ('PY', DATE '2024-10-28', DATE '2025-01-26'), ('CY', DATE '2025-10-27', DATE '2026-01-25')),
cur AS (SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900),
lfl AS (
  SELECT c.* FROM cur c JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = c.store_id AND s.is_current
  WHERE s.open_date IS NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure z JOIN p ON z.closure_start_date <= p.d1 AND z.closure_end_date >= p.d0 WHERE z.store_id = c.store_id)),
net AS (
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING (store_key) JOIN p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE st.store_id < 900
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.per, st.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 WHERE st.store_id < 900)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_quarter, l.region,
  round((sum(CASE WHEN per = 'CY' THEN amt END) / sum(CASE WHEN per = 'PY' THEN amt END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM net JOIN lfl l USING (store_id) GROUP BY l.region ORDER BY l.region
